en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> did not cease to advise me<sup>saww</sup> with brushing of the teeth to the extent that I<sup>saww</sup> feared of loosening the teeth or becoming toothless’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn Mahbub form al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The Holy prophet has said, “Jibril continued urging me to brush my teeth, until I became fearful of the falling off of my teeth.’””
